newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Mt Leyshon tells shareholders to wait.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Mt Leyshon tells shareholders to wait.

text.p: Mt Leyshon Gold Mines Ltd said on Thursday that shareholders were advised not to sell their holdings ahead of an expected takeover offer from St Barbara Mines Ltd.
Mt Leyshon said in a statement it had received notice that takeover documents should be issued in two weeks.
Directors advised shareholders to wait until the proposal has been considered and a formal response issued.
Mt Leyshon said on Wednesday it was receptive to the proposed merger offer, given the limited life of its Mt Leyshon mine in Queensland.
St Barbara has proposed a merger to create a gold company with annual production about 350,000 ounces and a resource base of about 4.8 million ounces.

St Barbara said it would offer 32 of its shares for each 10 Mt Leyshon shares, a 22 percent premium for Mt Leyshon based on Tuesday's closing prices of A$0.80 for St Barbara and A$2.10 for Mt Leyshon.
St Barbara was trading down four cents at A$0.74 at 10.35 a.m. (2335 GMT), while Mt Leyshon, held 75.6 percent by Normandy Mining Ltd, was untraded from Wednesday's A$2.12 close.
